carrier_name: Mutual of Omaha (United of Omaha Life Insurance Company)

must_contain: United of Omaha Life Insurance Company

extraction_notes:
This is a multi-product Mutual of Omaha "Group Insurance Proposal" bundling many coverage lines (Basic Life/AD&D, Voluntary Life/AD&D, STD, LTD, Voluntary Dental, Voluntary Critical Illness, Voluntary Hospital Indemnity, Voluntary Accident, Voluntary Vision), each on its own labeled section beginning with a bold section title (e.g. "VOLUNTARY DENTAL INSURANCE") and an "Alternate:" number. Each product section has its own ELIGIBILITY, BENEFIT SUMMARY, PARTICIPATION AND COST SUMMARY, and ADDITIONAL BENEFITS blocks.

For DENTAL specifically (section titled "VOLUNTARY DENTAL INSURANCE", ~pages 11-15 in this doc):
- Eligibility defines two classes: Class 1 = employees enrolled in "High Plan", Class 2 = employees enrolled in "Low Plan". These are two separate plan designs/tiers, NOT one plan - extract both as separate plans.
- "BENEFIT SUMMARY - CLASS 1" and "BENEFIT SUMMARY - CLASS 2" tables each list: Policy Year Deductible (Type A waived; Type B/C individual $ amount, family = 3x individual), Policy Year Maximum, Orthodontic Lifetime Maximum, Orthodontic Coverage (usually "Dependent Children Only"), and Coverage Levels (Type A/B/C/Orthodontics percentages).
- COBRA administration note appears per class - not a benefit, just admin note.
- Rate tables appear later under "PARTICIPATION AND COST SUMMARY" as "COST SUMMARY - HIGH - CLASS 1" and "COST SUMMARY - LOW - CLASS 2", each with rows for Employee Only, Employee+Spouse, Employee+Child(ren), Employee+Family, giving Assumed Lives, Monthly Rate, Monthly Premium, Annual Premium Sub-Total. Use the "Monthly Rates" column values as the per-tier premium rates for record_quote_data.
- Rate Guarantee for dental is 1 Year (shorter than other lines' 2-year guarantee) - note this can differ per product even within the same document.
- "COVERED SERVICES - CLASS 1" and "COVERED SERVICES - CLASS 2" pages (separate pages later in doc) list detailed Type A/B/C/Orthodontics covered service lists with frequency limitations - these are supplemental detail, not needed for the standard benefit summary map but useful context (e.g. dentures/bridges/crowns replacement frequency differs: Class 1 = once in 10 years, Class 2 = once in 5 years).
- No out-of-network specific $ figures disclosed beyond "cumulative deductible/max across in/out network"; out-of-network reimbursement basis is 90th percentile R&C.
- Total plan count for Dental product = 2 (Class 1 High, Class 2 Low). Do not confuse with the other ~8 non-dental products in the same document (Life, AD&D, STD, LTD, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Accident, Vision) which should be ignored when task specifies "Dental only" extraction.
- Document also has a final "REQUIREMENTS AND ASSUMPTIONS" section (last 2 pages) with SIC code, situs state, general proposal conditions, and dental-specific administrative notes (Dental Bid Qualifications, Dental Enrollment, Dental Takeover, Dental Work in Progress) - these are administrative/contractual, not per-benefit cost-share data.
